verdict.line: You lose reps if you facetank Infected Cleaver throws before level 3; you win once W (Dark Procession) traps him and you fight at close quarters.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo's Adrenaline Rush regenerates a portion of his max health every second and Infected Cleaver pokes for max-health damage at 975 range on only a 4s cooldown, so he wins the long-range poke war before you have a wall. Once W (Dark Procession) is up at level 3, you can block his retreat, land E (Mourning Mist)'s armor shred and slow, and win the close-quarters fight his own kit can't escape from without burning Sadism early.

theirWindow.when: Q (Infected Cleaver) is up, no minions between you
theirWindow.what: He throws a free, low-risk cleaver at 975 range that scales off your max health. Stay behind minions or let your Mist Walkers soak it instead of standing in the open.

yourWindow.when: W (Dark Procession) is off cooldown near the wave
yourWindow.what: Drop the wall to cut his escape path, then mark him with E before trading. In close quarters he has no reliable disengage besides Sadism, so this is your highest-value all-in window.

powerCurve.note: Free cleaver poke, no wall yet
W unlocks, wall-trap all-ins open up
His AoE sustain vs your split push

start.why: Highest measured win rate at the start slot (52.8% over 53 games) and the extra damage/sustain lets you actually win trades once the wall pins him in range.

boots.why: Highest measured win rate on boots (53.5% over 43 games); cuts down the basic-attack and auto-reliant damage he adds back once Masochism is active.

core.why: Applies Grievous Wounds, directly cutting Adrenaline Rush's per-second regen and Sadism's burst heal — this is the single biggest lever in the matchup.
The empowered-auto spike punishes him for standing in your Mourning Mist zone during the close-quarters trades you're forcing.
Cooldown reduction lets you threaten W and E more often per recall, keeping the wall-and-mark pattern on a tighter loop.
More armor shred stacks with E and the slow lets you stick to him once he's low and trying to walk off.

situational.when: he starts stacking armor to blunt your physical damage
the game goes long and you're splitting side lanes with the Maiden

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended, close-quarters fights your wall creates and converts to healing that outlasts his sustain once Grievous Wounds is online. Note master-tier Yorick players run Grasp of the Undying instead (1,394 games) — better if you plan to out-regen his early poke rather than win the burst trade.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite carries the highest measured win rate (57.4%); the Grievous Wounds from Ignite stacks with Executioner's Calling to shut down Sadism's heal during your all-in window. Flash + Teleport is the highest-pick option (54%) if you'd rather prioritize scaling and side-lane pressure.

playing.title: Block cleavers with minions
playing.detail: Use the wave and your Mist Walkers to eat Infected Cleaver throws instead of tanking max-health damage at range before you have W.

playing.title: Wall before you all-in
playing.detail: Drop W (Dark Procession, cd 20/18/16/14/12s) to cut his retreat the moment you commit to a trade.

playing.title: Mark, then burst in close
playing.detail: Lead with E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred and slow, then follow with your empowered Q (Last Rites) auto — your close-range output beats his.

playing.title: Rush Grievous Wounds if stalled
playing.detail: If the lane isn't resolving by your first back, prioritize Executioner's Calling; it cuts both Adrenaline Rush and Sadism's regen.

playing.title: Respect his low-health spike
playing.detail: Masochism (cd 7s) gives him AD scaling off missing health for a few seconds — expect his hardest trades right as he dips low, not just at execute range.

playing.title: Don't waste ult on skirmishes
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles sits on a much longer cooldown (160-100s) than his Sadism (75s); save it for fights you can actually close out.

playing.title: Push the level-3 spike
playing.detail: The moment W comes online is your first real kill window — chain it with E's mark immediately.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and the quoted win rates come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical and timing analysis is my own reading of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid early game (Q) by using [p] and minions to block it. Yorick is stronger in close quarters so use [W] and [E] often to try to kill him.
